verdict.rationale: Ghostty is a GUI terminal emulator, and nothing in the evidence documents a headless or CI mode for running the product itself. AppleScript drives GUI windows, and the runtime probe found no remote-control or IPC interface; the `+` CLI actions only cover config and listing actions. libghostty is a developer building block for constructing terminals, not a headless mode of Ghostty, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
